posts.author: Nowis-337
posts.body:
HUH? Where's Harold?
After his heroic return in 2024, Harold is now... somewhere! But it's up to you to find out where! We don't even know!
Could Harold have gone missing? Is he hiding on purpose? Or maybe he's just in a big crowd of suspiciously Harold-looking guys! Does Harold even know where he is?
Join us this year in the
2025 Harold Game Jam
hosted by the
RPG Beta Tester Server
starting July 1st!
This year's theme is:
Where's Harold?
​
The theme is optional, and how you interpret it is up to you!
However, there are
Require Elements
(A character, a location and a line of dialogue) that must included in your game. These will be announced once the jam starts.
Required Elements:
Character
: An Archeologist
Dialogue
: “Even after everything you did to try and prevent it.”
Location
: Wildlife Preserve
​
Check the link for more details on the prize, schedule and rules:
https://itch.io/jam/harold-jam-2025
